score_units: unit interval; tables multiply scores and SD by 100

protocol.search_execution: Development-only deterministic-candidate-cache replay; no extra adaptive training.
protocol.selection: Maximize lab-0 development primary, minimize development loss on ties, retain earlier candidate on exact ties
protocol.checkpoint_selection: Development evaluation every five rounds within the 100-round training schedule
protocol.random_6: D00 plus six distinct draws from D01--D11
protocol.bayes_6: D00, two seeded random warm starts, then four Gaussian-process expected-improvement proposals
protocol.bayes_kernel: Matern nu=2.5, fixed unit length scales; normalize_y; alpha=1e-6
protocol.bayes_acquisition: EI xi=0.01; two prespecified Random@6 warm-start proposals
protocol.exhaustive_12: All twelve registered designs, not a Cartesian hyperparameter grid
protocol.exact_random_6: Average selected-model metrics over all 462 six-of-eleven subsets, integrating proposal-order ties; not prediction ensembling
protocol.reference_rows: Historical history-enabled BioCoLoop at one and ten laboratories; not the Direct condition
protocol.comparison_scope: One-versus-ten laboratories includes data, evaluation-evidence and computation access differences.

training_cost.timing_scope: sum of fit timers, not wall time; excludes separate scoring/feature/addon/bootstrap/orchestration time
training_cost.partial_scope: cost counts only independently verified COMPLETE studies
